messages:
Aisha (CS): Quick heads-up — prepping Borealis QBR. They've spiked embeddings and chat tokens after onboarding. Need a short runbook: 1) spend forecast for next 30d, 2) token-econ mitigations we can recommend, 3) enablement talking points. Can owners please chime in?
Ben (FinOps): Got it. Can you paste the current 7d token breakdown? I want model + embeddings split and cost-per-token estimate.
Carmen (Onboarding): Onboarding status: prod rollout 2 weeks in, 4 power users. They're running large batch imports for vectors. I flagged them about batching but they pushed full import yesterday.
Aisha (CS): thx Carmen. Ben — quick query in analytics:
```
SELECT date, model, token_type, sum(tokens) as tot_tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_borealis' AND date >= current_date - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1 DESC;
```
Ben (FinOps): Nice. I'll run that and return a forecast.
cs-alert-bot: [Alert] account acct_borealis crossed 75% of monthly credits (threshold: 75%).
Devon (Solutions): If they're importing dense vectors, recommend: 1) switch to 8-bit quantization model for embeddings if acceptable, 2) enable prefix KV caching for chat flows, 3) batch imports into chunks of 5k rather than one shot. We have a config snippet:
```
embeddings:
  model: redwood-embed-small-8bit
  batch_size: 5000
  quant: int8
```
Aisha (CS): Good. Emma — can you nudge the PM to consider throttling the import or scheduling low-priority imports overnight?
Emma (Customer): Yeah we'll gate the importer. PM asked for concrete savings numbers to justify config changes.
Ben (FinOps): Forecast: if they keep current runrate, they'll hit 110% of committed credits in 14 days. If they adopt Devon's batch/quant suggestions and lower embedding size by 30% (approx), we project 40% slower burn — enough to stay under commit for 30d. I'll attach numbers in the QBR deck.
Carmen (Onboarding): I'll draft enablement script: one-pager on batching, model recommendations, and the UI steps to schedule imports (screenshots). ETA EOD tomorrow.
Aisha (CS): Action items:
- Ben: attach 7d breakdown + 30d forecast to thread (ETA 3pm PST)
- Devon: provide compact config diff + expected % savings (ETA EOD)
- Carmen: enablement one-pager + screenshots (ETA tomorrow EOD)
- Emma: confirm PM will gate imports and share acceptance (ETA today)
We'll use these for the QBR runbook and the renewal play.
Devon (Solutions): I'll also include a fallback model mapping for Dedicated vs Hosted if they need cheaper variants.
Ben (FinOps): uploaded forecast.xlsx to the QBR drive: https://redwood.app/drive/qbr/borealis/forecast.xlsx
Aisha (CS): Perfect. I'll assemble the QBR deck and tag you for reviews. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
cs-alert-bot: [Info] follow-up reminder set for 1829993398 (12h).
